VARIABLES coarse, fine, record, remaining, local, phase

    /\ coarse \in Stations \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in Stations \cup {NONE}
    /\ record \in 0..Budget
    /\ remaining \in 0..Budget
    /\ local \in [Stations -> 0..Budget]
    /\ phase \in [Stations -> {"idle", "coarse", "fine", "wrote"}]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ record = 0
    /\ remaining = Budget
    /\ local = [s \in Stations |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [s \in Stations |-> "idle"]

AcquireCoarse(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "idle"
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = s
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, record, remaining, local>>

AcquireFine(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "coarse"
    /\ coarse = s
    /\ fine = NONE
    /\ fine' = s
    /\ local' = [local EXCEPT ![s] = record]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "fine"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, record, remaining>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "fine"
    /\ fine = s
    /\ remaining > 0
    /\ record' = 1 + record
    /\ remaining' = remaining - 1
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "wrote"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, local>>

Release(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "wrote"
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, remaining, local>>

Abort(s) ==
    /\ phase[s] = "fine"
    /\ fine = s
    /\ remaining = 0
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = NONE
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, remaining, local>>

Next == \E s \in Stations : AcquireCoarse(s) \/ AcquireFine(s) \/ Commit(s) \/ Release(s) \/ Abort(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == record = Budget - remaining
================================================================================

NEXT Next
